name: sdr-extreme
description: Amateur radio and scanner desktop suite with RTL-SDR USB, HD Radio, digital decoders, KiwiSDR and MeshCore.
author: KQ4ESZ

scripts.build:linux: pnpm build:themes && pnpm build:native:linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux:dir: pnpm build:themes && pnpm build:native:linux && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.build:arch: pnpm build:themes && pnpm build:native:linux && electron-builder --linux pacman --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:x64: pnpm build:themes && node scripts/build-mac-icon.mjs && SDR_EXTREME_MAC_ARCH=x64 pnpm build:native:mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm build:themes && node scripts/build-mac-icon.mjs && SDR_EXTREME_MAC_ARCH=arm64 pnpm build:native:mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: pnpm build:win && pnpm release:checksums && node scripts/publish-release.mjs
